name: Longest run
brief: Write `longest_run(xs)`. It returns the length of the longest block of equal neighbours. An empty list gives 0.
how: Submit runs 5 hidden tests. Each answer is accepted when it is close to the expected value.
solution:
def longest_run(xs):
    best = run = 0
    prev = object()
    for x in xs:
        run = run + 1 if x == prev else 1
        prev = x
        best = max(best, run)
    return best
